basics.description: **Azure STIG Dashboard** — full-stack STIG compliance tracker for Azure workloads. This wizard provisions an App Service plan, backend + frontend Web Apps, PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Application Insights, and (optionally) wires Azure AD sign-in. Resources work in **Azure Commercial (portal.azure.com)** and **Azure Government (portal.azure.us)** — the cloud is auto-detected from the portal you launched from, but you can override it on the next step.

location.label: Azure region
location.toolTip: Pick a region in the cloud you signed in to. For Azure Gov, regions like usgovvirginia / usgovtexas are typical.

basics.name: organizationName
basics.label: Organization name
basics.toolTip: Short identifier for your org (3–14 lowercase letters/digits). Used as the prefix for every resource name (e.g. 'contoso' → 'contoso-stig-api').

constraints.validationMessage: 3–14 chars, lowercase letters/numbers, must start with a letter.

basics.name: cloudEnvironment
basics.label: Azure cloud environment
basics.toolTip: Choose the cloud you are deploying to. This adjusts hostname suffixes, the Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) authority, and the PostgreSQL DNS zone so the deployed app uses the correct sovereign endpoints.

basics.name: appServiceSku
basics.label: App Service plan SKU
basics.toolTip: Used when auto-size is disabled. For very small environments, keep auto-size enabled instead.

basics.name: autoSizeByTrackedHosts
basics.label: Auto-size from tracked host count
basics.toolTip: Recommended. Uses tracked host count to choose lower-cost defaults for SKU, scheduler, and diagnostics.

basics.name: trackedHostCount
basics.label: Estimated tracked hosts
basics.toolTip: Used when auto-size is enabled. 1-25 defaults to smallest footprint; 26-150 medium; 151+ larger footprint.

basics.name: enableScheduler
basics.label: Enable scheduled scans/alerts
basics.toolTip: If disabled, no timer-based scan orchestration or drift alerting is deployed.

basics.name: enableDiagnostics
basics.label: Enable centralized diagnostics (Log Analytics)
basics.toolTip: Can be a major monthly cost driver in small environments.

basics.name: businessHoursMode
basics.label: Business-hours mode
basics.toolTip: Runs scheduled scan jobs only during business hours in your selected timezone.

basics.name: businessHoursTimeZone
basics.label: Business-hours timezone
basics.toolTip: IANA timezone name such as UTC or America/New_York.

constraints.validationMessage: Use a valid IANA timezone name, for example UTC or America/New_York.

basics.name: autoShutdownOutsideBusinessHours
basics.label: Auto-stop app + DB outside business hours
basics.toolTip: When enabled with Scheduler + Business-hours mode, the Function app starts/stops backend, frontend, and PostgreSQL on a weekday schedule.

basics.name: mockMode
basics.label: Run in MOCK mode (no real Azure subscription data)
basics.toolTip: MOCK mode is great for demos. Leave at 'No' for production deployments.

subLabel.preValidation: Provide your Microsoft Entra app registration

options.text: **Easiest path:** clone the repo and run `./scripts/create-app-registration.ps1 -OrgName <your-org>`. It creates the app registration, exposes the API scope, defines admin/operator/auditor roles, sets the redirect URI, generates a client secret, and prints the three values you need to paste below. Otherwise create an app registration manually with the SPA redirect URI `https://<organization>-stig-web.<azurewebsites-suffix>` and an API scope `api://<client-id>/access_as_user`.

elements.name: azureTenantId
elements.label: Tenant ID
elements.toolTip: GUID of the Azure AD / Microsoft Entra tenant.

elements.name: azureClientSecret
elements.toolTip: App registration client secret. Will be stored as an App Service application setting (rotate to Key Vault references for production hardening).

constraints.validationMessage: Client secret must be at least 8 characters.

elements.name: dbAdminLogin
elements.label: Database admin login
elements.toolTip: Lowercase, must not be a reserved word (admin/root/etc.).

constraints.validationMessage: 3–16 chars, lowercase letters/digits, start with a letter.

elements.name: dbAdminPassword
elements.toolTip: 12+ chars, must include uppercase, lowercase, digit, and symbol.

constraints.validationMessage: 12+ chars including upper, lower, digit, and symbol.
